name: Red-team smurfing attempt (9 transfers per mule)

policy_clause.title: Mule-ring override
policy_clause.text: Payments to accounts that collect many transfers and forward them quickly, share phones or networks with other accounts, or sit at the centre of a transfer ring are held regardless of the disaster context.

notice.en: Your payment of ₹7,400 is on hold while we check it. Tap 'Appeal' to talk to us.

result.card_template: HOLD: ₹7,400 blocked pending analyst review. Context: p2p payment at 00:00 inside a disaster zone (severity 5). Fraud probability 1.00, mule-ring score 1.00.
